ttl.name: Propeller Shaft with Center Bearing Assembly (4WD)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.
Disconnect the 3 exhaust pipe supports and remove the exhaust center pipe assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Floor Heat Insulator NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 nuts and remove the front floor heat insulator No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Propeller Shaft with Center Bearing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and center bearing washers, and disconnect the propeller with center bearing shaft assembly.

item.ptxt: When removing, do not apply excessive force to the universal joints.
During removal, transport and storage, do not allow the No. 2 joint angle to be 20° or more.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the differential carrier assembly and propeller shaft assembly.
Remove the 4 nuts and 4 washers, and disconnect the propeller shaft assembly from the differential carrier assembly.
Put matchmarks on the transfer assembly and propeller shaft assembly.
Remove the 4 nuts and 4 washers, and disconnect the propeller shaft assembly from the transfer assembly.
